name: NovelEval
description: NovelEval is a new test set designed to evaluate large language models' ability to rank passages containing unknown or novel knowledge, addressing data contamination concerns in information retrieval benchmarks.
reputation: A niche benchmark introduced to probe contamination-resistant ranking of novel passages; it is mainly of research interest and not yet broadly established as a standard IR benchmark.
notes: Collected to verify model ranking ability on latest knowledge; used alongside permutation distillation for efficiency.
